source: Public-domain songs everyone knows, for the Atlas's graded tiers (the coach's own, not an exam board's list), written out for piano (tinyNotation: c = middle C, c' = the C above, C = the C below, GG = the G below that; # sharp, - flat; ~ ties). The right hand is the traditional melody note for note (an upbeat is written as rests in an opening bar); the left hand is the coach's own simple accompaniment on the song's usual chords. 'after' names tunes in this file that come first.

tunes.title: Hot Cross Buns (hands in octaves)
tunes.right: b4 a g2 b4 a g2 g8 g g g a a a a b4 a g2
tunes.left: B4 A G2 B4 A G2 G8 G G G A A A A B4 A G2
tunes.text: Both hands play the tune an octave apart. Right thumb on G, left thumb on B: the right hand plays fingers 3-2-1 while the left plays 1-2-3. Keep the quavers even in both hands.

tunes.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star (in G)
tunes.right: g4 g d' d' e' e' d'2 c'4 c' b b a a g2 d'4 d' c' c' b b a2 d'4 d' c' c' b b a2 g4 g d' d' e' e' d'2 c'4 c' b b a a g2
tunes.left: GG1 C2 GG2 C2 GG2 D2 GG2 GG2 C2 GG2 D2 GG2 C2 GG2 D2 GG1 C2 GG2 C2 GG2 D2 GG2
tunes.text: Twinkle in G. The left hand sits on the low G with its pinky and plays G, C and D, changing on the half bar. Look for where the left hand moves: it's always when the tune's long note comes.

tunes.title: London Bridge Is Falling Down
tunes.right: g4. a8 g4 f e f g2 d4 e f2 e4 f g2 g4. a8 g4 f e f g2 d2 g2 e4 c2.
tunes.left: C2 G2 C2 G2 G2 F2 C2 G2 C2 G2 C2 G2 G1 C1
tunes.text: The dotted crotchet at the start of the line is long-short: count 'one-and-two' before the quaver. Left hand pinky on C; it plays C and G, and G-F when the tune falls to D.

tunes.title: Old MacDonald Had a Farm
tunes.right: g4 g g d e e d2 b4 b a a g2. d4 g g g d e e d2 b4 b a a g2. d8 d g4 g g d8 d g4 g g2 g8 g g4 g8 g g4 g8 g g g g4 g g g g d e e d2 b4 b a a g1
tunes.left: GG1 C2 GG2 GG2 D2 GG1 GG1 C2 GG2 GG2 D2 GG1 GG2 D2 GG2 D2 GG2 D2 GG2 D2 GG1 C2 GG2 GG2 D2 GG1
tunes.text: The 'moo moo here' bars repeat one note in the right hand: keep the quavers light and even. The left hand rocks between G and D underneath.

tunes.title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat
tunes.right: c4. c4. c4 d8 e4. e4 d8 e4 f8 g2. c'8 c' c' g g g e e e c c c g4 f8 e4 d8 c2.
tunes.text: Your first tune in 6/8: two big beats a bar, each one split into three. Count 'one-two-three, four-five-six'. In bar 5 the right hand jumps up to the top C with the pinky, then walks down in threes.

tunes.title: Frère Jacques (Are You Sleeping?)
tunes.right: f4 g a f f g a f a b- c'2 a4 b- c'2 c'8 d' c' b- a4 f c'8 d' c' b- a4 f f4 c f2 f4 c f2
tunes.left: F2 C2 F2 C2 F2 C2 F2 C2 F2 C2 F2 C2 F2 C2 F2 C2
tunes.text: In F major: every B is B flat, a black key, played with finger 4. Each line comes twice. The left hand rocks between F and C the whole way.

tunes.title: Yankee Doodle
tunes.right: g8 g a b g b a d g g a b g4 f#4 g8 g a b c' b a g f# d e f# g4 g4
tunes.left: GG4 D4 GG4 D4 GG4 D4 GG4 D4 GG4 D4 C2 D2 GG2
tunes.text: A quick march in 2/4. Every F is F sharp. The right hand dips down to the low D in bar 2; the left hand marches G-D, G-D underneath.

tunes.title: Happy Birthday
tunes.right: r2 g8 g a4 g c' b2 g8 g a4 g d' c'2 g8 g g'4 e' c' b a f'8 f' e'4 c' d' c'2.
tunes.text: It starts on the last beat of the bar: count 'one, two' and come in on 'three'. The big leap is in bar 5, an octave up to the high G: get your hand there during the two quavers before it.

tunes.title: Aura Lee (Love Me Tender)
tunes.right: d4 g f# g a e a2 g4 f# e f# g1 d4 g f# g a e a2 g4 f# e f# g1 b4 b b2 b4 b b2 b4 a g a b1 b4 b c' b a e a2 g4 f# b a g1
tunes.left: GG1 AA1 D1 GG1 GG1 AA1 D1 GG1 GG1 BB1 GG1 GG1 GG2 C2 AA1 GG2 D2 GG1
tunes.text: A slow, smooth song from 1861 (Elvis sang it as 'Love Me Tender'). Join every note to the next, and hold the long notes their full length. The left hand plays one long note a bar.

tunes.title: Amazing Grace
tunes.right: r2 d4 g2 b8 g b2 a4 g2 e4 d2 d4 g2 b8 g b2 a4 d'2.~ d'2 b4 d'2 b8 g b2 a4 g2 e4 d2 d4 g2 b8 g b2 a4 g2.
tunes.left: r2. GG2. GG2. C2. GG2. GG2. GG2 D4 D2. GG2. GG2. GG2. C2. GG2. GG2. GG2 D4 GG2.
tunes.text: A slow waltz that starts on beat 3. The high D in the middle is tied across the bar: hold it for five beats, then go on.

tunes.title: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
tunes.right: r2 d4 g g8 a g f# e4 e e a4 a8 b a g f#4 d d b4 b8 c' b a g4 e d8 d e4 a f# g2 r4
tunes.left: r2. GG2. C2. AA2. D2. BB2. GG2. C4 D2 GG2 r4
tunes.text: A bright waltz. Each line climbs a step higher than the last: G, then A, then B. The left hand follows it down one note a bar.

tunes.title: Silent Night
tunes.text: Gentle and smooth, in a slow three. The left hand holds one note a bar on C, F or G; the right hand does the moving. Lean into the long notes and let them ring.

tunes.title: What Shall We Do with the Drunken Sailor?
tunes.right: a4 a8 a a4 a8 a a4 d f a g4 g8 g g4 g8 g g4 c e g a4 a8 a a4 a8 a a4 b c' d' c'4 a g e d2 d2 a2 a2 a4 d f a g2 g2 g4 c e g a2 a2 a4 b c' d' c'4 a g e d2 d2
tunes.left: D2 A2 D2 A2 C2 G2 C2 G2 D2 A2 D2 A2 C1 D1 D2 A2 D2 A2 C2 G2 C2 G2 D2 A2 D2 A2 C1 D1
tunes.text: A sea shanty in D Dorian: like D minor, but every B is B natural, so there's no key signature. The left hand moves between D and C positions every two bars.
